Using only the aromatic pattern established earlier, which positional isomer of that formula is supported?
Combine the molecular formula and positional assignment into one provisional structure.
Write the proposed structure as a condensed formula that makes the relative ring positions explicit.
Would either alternative positional isomer reproduce the aromatic pattern established in the third step? Briefly compare them.
